title: I trusted my own measure first
text: Any new check runs on the user's finished cut first and on my draft second. It's kept only if it separates them, or it's kept as a list to look at and said to be one (like hks_cut_check).

source.heading: My own mistakes, and what stops each one (agent, 2026-11-25)

confirm: For each new check used, what did it give on the user's finished cut and on the draft?
